messages:
Alex H: Opening PR to clarify SOC2 audit export examples and fix a broken SDK link in the retention section. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/884
Maria R: Thanks — could you also add an example showing TTL vs redaction for tenant-scoped logs? Legal wants explicit wording.
Alex H: Yep, planning to add two short snippets (curl + python). Quick paste of the python snippet I'm thinking:
```python
# export tenant audit log
resp = client.audit.export(tenant_id='acct-123', format='jsonl', redaction='partial')
print(resp.url)
```
Jordan P: That looks fine. For SOC2 wording, avoid 'forever' — use 'retention period' and show TTL defaults. Add a note about customer-configurable TTL.
Samir K: Also, one broken internal link: /docs/audit#export-samples -> currently 404. I can push a fix if someone points me to the correct anchor.
Alex H: Anchor is 'export-format-samples' — thanks. Samir can you update the link in the PR?
Samir K: On it. Will update the link and add a brief sentence about encryption at rest + KMS rotation.
Dani L: FYI legal asked for a sentence that data exported for audits is hashed unless expressly requested in plaintext. Can we add that as an optional flag in the snippet? e.g., `include_plaintext=False`.
Alex H: Added note in the docs and optional param in the python snippet. Pushed an amend to the PR.
docs-bot: CI passed — 5 checks OK. Preview: https://deploy-preview.redwood.dev/884
Maria R: Quick wording nit: change 'we retain' -> 'customers may configure retention up to 365 days by default' ... we'll iterate.
legal-bot: Legal review requested by @Maria R. Expected turnaround 48h.
Alex H: Great — tagging @Jordan P to help with one-liners for SOC2/conceptual language.
Jordan P: I'll draft 2 lines and post them here by EOD. :thumbsup: 
Maria R: Thanks all — if legal approves let's merge midday tomorrow. :rocket:
Alex H: Merge plan: canary read only to staging, then full publish after 2 hours monitoring.
Samir K: Deployed link fix to branch, pushed commit 3.
Alex H: Last_message: thanks everyone, continuing in PR comments.
